name: oct_mini
notes: MINI: the headline question only. base vs r1_sft on the 44 direct value probes, 2 samples each, judged against C_000, C_001 and one control (deferential). No prompted ceiling, no scenarios, no adversarial split. Gives gain_own, gain_specific (C_001 vs C_000), the control, win rate and coherence, with intervals over 44 probes. Its responses are NOT reusable by oct_fast (different probe set), so expanding later means generating again.
